_comment: Thunder Bay dealers. `platform: convertus` dealers (Wayne Toyota, Superior Hyundai) are scraped browser-free via the dealer's same-origin Convertus VMS JSON proxy — cp is the Convertus company id (discover it by watching the ajax-vehicles.php request the used-inventory page makes). Other dealers fall back to the generic HTML scraper and only yield data when SCRAPE_JS_FALLBACK=1 (they render client-side and/or sit behind bot challenges).
